headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.11
summary: This release adds AI-powered crash analysis with a built-in provider list, makes the launcher catch game crashes that slip past the crash handler, and polishes the update screen with the APK download size and colored changelog chips.

items.text: Added AI-powered crash-log analysis: the game crash dialog and the launcher crash screen can now send the crash log, together with the list of enabled mods, to a configurable AI provider that answers in the app's current language.

Added a dedicated AI tab in Settings with a built-in provider list (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Together, Cerebras, Ollama local and cloud, LM Studio, or a custom endpoint), native Anthropic and Gemini API formats, and a searchable model list fetched straight from the provider.

The launcher now detects when the game exits back to the launcher as a crash even when nothing was captured by the crash handler, by scanning the engine's crashdumps folder, and shows the same crash log dialog with mod attribution.
The update details screen now shows the APK download size before you start downloading, and changelog section titles render as colored chips (orange for Fixes, green for Features).
Hardened game crash detection: the session marker is written synchronously so detection survives a hard process death, and rapid launcher resumes can no longer show the crash dialog twice.
